consequence.statement: The tsdb_shipper storage configuration is now properly generated in environments with using_boltdb_shipper set to false, correcting previous behavior where it was omitted.

original.statement: Loki now generates tsdb_shipper storage configuration even when using_boltdb_shipper is set to false.

decision.reason: [ev-cc5436d99c53] is a one-line Bug Fixes entry. It says Loki now generates the tsdb_shipper storage_config even when using_boltdb_shipper is false. So an exposed environment that does nothing gets a generated config that now includes tsdb_shipper storage settings. Nothing in the evidence says anything fails, is rejected, is ignored or must be migrated, so behavior-change (review class) is the strongest kind the evidence supports. The 'medium' severity is a judgment call that the excerpt does not state directly.
